KAISER PERMANENTE® : Gold 80 HMO

Carrier: Kaiser. Plan type: HMO. Period: 2026-01-01.

28 benefits are placed in CARIN SBC benefit categories. 3 benefits have no code in the SBC benefit category code system and are listed, by identity only, in the bps-unmapped-benefit extension.

Converted from Benefit Plan Standard document KAISER_CA_GOLD_80_HMO (schema version 1.1.0).

extension.valueString: Gold 80 HMO | Coverage Period: Beginning on or after 01/01/2026 | Coverage for: Individual/Family | Plan Type: HMO
What is the out-of-pocket limit for this plan? $9,200 Individual / $18,400 Family
Primary care visit to treat an injury or illness: $40 / visit; Non-Plan Provider: Not covered
Preventive care/ screening/ immunization: No charge
Diagnostic test (x-ray, blood work): X-ray: $75 / encounter; Lab tests: $40 / encounter. (The document also prints a $40 lab copay; this file carries only the x-ray value.)
Non-preferred brand drugs (Tier 2): $60 / prescription (retail) - aligns with preferred brand cost-sharing when approved through the formulary exception process
Specialty drugs (Tier 4): 20% coinsurance up to $250 / prescription. (The document also prints a $250 per-prescription cap; this file carries only the 20% coinsurance.)
Facility fee (e.g., ambulatory surgery center): $190 / procedure. Physician/surgeon fees: Not Applicable - included in the Facility fee.
Emergency room care: $350 / visit. Copayment waived if admitted directly to the hospital as an inpatient.
Facility fee (e.g., hospital room): $375 / day up to 5 days
Mental health outpatient services: $40 / individual visit. Inpatient services: $375 / day up to 5 days
Childbirth/delivery facility services: $375 / day up to 5 days. Professional fees are included in the facility fee.
Home health care: $30 / visit. Rehabilitation services: Outpatient: $40 / visit. Habilitation services: Outpatient: $40 / visit.
Skilled nursing care: $150 / day up to 5 days. Durable medical equipment: 20% coinsurance.
Hospice service: No charge. Children's eye exam: No charge. Children's glasses: No charge. Children's dental check-up: No charge.
Services Your Plan Generally Does NOT Cover: Chiropractic Care. Other Covered Services: Acupuncture (plan provider referred)
